persons.name: Joseph (or James) Cooper

present_on_scene_date.note: Griffith to Heald, 13 Jan 1820 (Draper Coll.), as reported by Quaife. No source takes a roll call on the afternoon of 14 August 1812; this is read from the evidence below.

persons.note: Son of Mrs. Burns. Stepson of Thomas Burns. A. H. Edwards (via Kirkland App. G) says the scalped girl's father, a Cooper, was killed; Kirkland wrongly identifies him with surgeon's mate John Cooper (who had resigned). Quaife resolves the Coopers as Mrs. Burns's children by her first marriage. After 14 August: Killed with the militia.
